population: B2B clean-train folds0-3, fixed clean V8 order; fold4=611 sealed until train-only Pareto gate
online_observation: one frozen Target answer at depth7 and one at depth8; compare order-insensitive normalized answer sets, with no gold/reference answer or exact fidelity visible
early_rule: if depth7 and depth8 normalized answer sets are identical and contain at least nine distinct answers, stop anchors 0.60 through 0.90 at depth8; otherwise stop them at depth10
high_fidelity_rule: if 0.95 is requested, always stop it at depth10; all five stop depths remain nondecreasing
baseline: single-call fixed depth10 at all anchors; same V8 candidate order
rationale: ten-answer QAMPARI makes nine predicted answers a necessary but insufficient condition for 0.90 list-F1; stability tests a distinct Target-behavior signal
cost_ledger: report final-context fraction separately from lower-bound sum of context tokens over all necessary Target calls; exclude shared prompt and generated tokens from lower bound, and assume no KV reuse
train_only_gate: the frozen rule must preserve or increase both 0.90 successes and Complete while lowering mean final-context fraction; if not, leave fold4=611 sealed
